turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hello. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi. My train to Riverside at three fifteen has been cancelled.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. The train has a technical problem. When do you need to get there?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Before six. I'm invited to a family dinner, and I don't want to miss it.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: The next train is at four forty, but it arrives at ten past six.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's too late for me. Is there any other way to get there before six?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: There's a replacement bus at three forty-five. It takes about two hours, so it arrives at about five forty-five. Your ticket is valid on it.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Oh, that's good news. Is there anything faster? I'd like to arrive a bit earlier.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: There's an express coach at four from the bus station across the road. It arrives at about five thirty. Your train ticket isn't valid on it, but I can refund your ticket. The coach is twenty dollars, so it's eight dollars more.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Then I'll save the money and take the replacement bus. Where does it leave from?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: From the bus stop on the left as you leave the station. Look for the yellow sign.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. So, the bus at three forty-five, from the stop on the left, and I don't need a new ticket.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That's right. I hope you get there in time.
